notes: Official Fed/ECB/UN news and official economic calendars refresh automatically.
News classification is a conservative headline risk rule, not semantic alpha.
Fed expectation uses a named nonmeeting-month futures anchor or a single-meeting day-weighted contract; not FedWatch probabilities.
Policy surprises require an archived premeeting expectation and subsequently published target rate.
No verified CPI/jobs consensus forecast feed is available; those surprises remain missing.
All required public sources must be healthy for new entries. No automatic live promotion.
